children: Overview
U.S. lodging REIT's Q3 net income rose and adjusted FFO per share grew 10%
Company's Q3 comparable RevPAR increased 6.6% year-over-year
Quarterly dividend raised 22% to $0.11 per share
Outlook
DiamondRock raises 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $322 mln-$327 mln from $310 mln-$320 mln
Company lifts 2026 adjusted FFO guidance to $256.5 mln-$261.5 mln from $245.5 mln-$255.5 mln
DiamondRock expects 2026 comparable RevPAR growth of 4.75%-5.25%, up from 2.5%-4.0%
Result Drivers
HEALTHY DEMAND AND HIGHER RATES - Co said both transient and group segments saw strong demand and higher average daily rates, driving revenue growth
OPERATING EFFICIENCIES - Co attributed outsized Hotel Adjusted EBITDA growth to operating efficiencies across its portfolio
RENOVATED HOTELS - Co said ramp-up of recently renovated hotels is expected to support continued earnings growth
